'''''Nym's Revenge''''' was the title of an unauthorized [[Painting/Legends|painting]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]. It showed the angry looking Nym gripping a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] at his throat and lifting him up into the air with only one hand, while pointing [[Nym's slugthrower-carbine|his slugthrower carbine]] at him with the other hand.

It was later adopted by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] for morale purposes.

==Behind the scenes==
''Nym's Revenge'' is a painting in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players receive it as a reward during the [[:w:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]] quest line and can use it to decorate their [[:w:c:swg:Housing|houses]].
